method: Normalized errors g_b=(L(b+2)−κL(b))/ℓ^b lie in the offset-2 Katz envelope with T_b g_b = ℓ g_{b+1} (ExactAtkin.errors). The offset-3 tail of one U/D step reduces into F_ℓ + F_ℓ f̄ (U_tail, D_tail via AtkinOBrienFinal.transfer; tail_reduce). Coefficient functionals killing 1 and f̄ then see ḡ_{b+1} through residues mod ℓ² of U(B_k/E²), D(B_k/E²); a kernel-decided check over F_ℓ^n propagates ḡ_b ≠ 0 (ExactAtkin.step, exact_of_model). Base: the mod-ℓ² partition determinant (SmallThreshold.fail_of_detOk).

certificates.generator: scripts/boylanwebb/gen_exact_atkin.py (proposal only; all lists, products, inverses, Eisenstein formulas and finite checks re-verified by decide +kernel)
certificates.basis: Δ^j E4^a cusp forms of weight 2(ℓ−1): 13: ΔE4³, Δ²; 17: ΔE4⁵, Δ²E4²; 19: ΔE4⁶, Δ²E4³, Δ³; 23: ΔE4⁸, Δ²E4⁵, Δ³E4²
certificates.independent_check: A Python model (direct q-series mod ℓ², independent of the Lean lists) gave the same nonvanishing for every admissible state at both U and D steps before formalization; numerics in scripts/frontier/pattern/bigm.log give b=m (Atkin index) for m ≤ 16.

controls.negative_control: Rejected by the kernel: a perturbed coefficient in the 13 divisibility certificate; the 13 D-step check with the observation zeroed; the 17 D-step check with both tau entries zero; the false claim bEll 19 6 = 5.

scope.proved: b_ℓ(m) = 2⌊m/2⌋+1 for all m ≥ 1 and exactness of ℓ^b ∣ L(b+2) − κL(b) at every b ≥ 1, ℓ ∈ {13,17,19,23}.
scope.also_proved: Partition-number form (AtkinExactPartition.partition_ℓ): for every b ≥ 1 and c ∈ ℤ_ℓ some n with 24 ∣ ℓ^b n+1 has ℓ^(b+1) ∤ p((ℓ^(b+2)n+1)/24) − c·p((ℓ^b n+1)/24); numerically at ℓ=13, b=1 every c mod 169 fails within 17 values of n.
not_proved: Primes ℓ ≥ 37 (rank ≥ 2) are not covered by this method as formalized (it assumes ℓ ≤ 24, dim S_{ℓ−1} = 1).
